2607.03103.title: SNR-Adaptive Unified Diffusion for Multi-Task Medical Image Segmentation
2607.03103.paper_summary: Clinical cardiac imaging pipelines currently deploy separate models for each dataset and modality, incurring redundant training costs and precluding knowledge sharing across anatomically related tasks. Consolidating semi-supervised learning, unsupervised domain adaptation, and domain generalisation into one model is therefore a practical necessity, yet naive joint training exposes a fundamental barrier: conflicting label semantics between datasets collapse LA Dice from 90.31\% to 83.38\%, while gradient imbalance across tasks of unequal complexity suppresses the weaker tasks throughout training. We present UniT-Diff, a unified diffusion segmentation framework that resolves these conflicts through three targeted mechanisms. An 11-channel task-specific output space physically partitions label categories, eliminating cross-task gradient sign reversal by construction. SNR-Adaptive Task Conditioning (SATC) scales the task token by the log signal-to-noise ratio of the current diffusion timestep, suppressing domain-specific bias during coarse denoising and restoring full task guidance as the signal clears. Task-Type-Aware Conditional Dropout (TTACD) permanently removes the task token for domain-generalisation inputs, routing them through a shared neutral pathway that draws on cross-dataset cardiac anatomy rather than source-vendor statistics. Under a single parameter set, UniT-Diff surpasses independently trained task-specific baselines on all three benchmarks simultaneously: +0.87\% on LA, +1.77\% on MMWHS, and +0.88\% on MNMS.
2607.03103.paper_summary_zh: 臨床心臟影像處理流程目前為每個數據集和模態部署了單獨的模型，這導致了冗餘的訓練成本，並阻礙了在解剖相關任務之間的知識共享。因此，將半監督學習、無監督領域適應和領域泛化整合為一個模型是實際上的必要，但天真的聯合訓練暴露出一個根本性障礙：數據集之間衝突的標籤語義使得左心房Dice從90.31\%降至83.38\%，而不同複雜度任務之間的梯度不平衡在整個訓練過程中抑制了較弱的任務。我們提出了UniT-Diff，一個統一的擴散分割框架，通過三個針對性的機制解決這些衝突。11通道的任務特定輸出空間在物理上劃分了標籤類別，通過結構消除了跨任務梯度符號反轉。SNR自適應任務條件（SATC）根據當前擴散時間步的對數信噪比縮放任務標記，抑制了粗糙去噪過程中的領域特定偏差，並在信號清晰時恢復完整的任務指導。任務類型感知條件隨機失活（TTACD）對於領域泛化輸入永久移除任務標記，將其通過一個共享的中立通道路由，該通道依賴於跨數據集的心臟解剖學，而非源供應商統計。在單一參數集下，UniT-Diff在所有三個基準上同時超越了獨立訓練的任務特定基準：左心房+0.87\%，MMWHS+1.77\%，MNMS+0.88\%。
